From 0024430e920f2900654ad83cd081cf52e02a3ef5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Nathan Chancellor <nathan@kernel.org>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2021 12:01:06 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] x86/build: Fix location of '-plugin-opt=' flags

Commit b33fff07e3e3 ("x86, build: allow LTO to be selected") added a
couple of '-plugin-opt=' flags to KBUILD_LDFLAGS because the code model
and stack alignment are not stored in LLVM bitcode.

However, these flags were added to KBUILD_LDFLAGS prior to the
emulation flag assignment, which uses ':=', so they were overwritten
and never added to $(LD) invocations.

The absence of these flags caused misalignment issues in the
AMDGPU driver when compiling with CONFIG_LTO_CLANG, resulting in
general protection faults.

Shuffle the assignment below the initial one so that the flags are
properly passed along and all of the linker flags stay together.

At the same time, avoid any future issues with clobbering flags by
changing the emulation flag assignment to '+=' since KBUILD_LDFLAGS is
already defined with ':=' in the main Makefile before being exported for
modification here as a result of commit:

  ce99d0bf312d ("kbuild: clear LDFLAGS in the top Makefile")

Fixes: b33fff07e3e3 ("x86, build: allow LTO to be selected")
Reported-by: Anthony Ruhier <aruhier@mailbox.org>
Signed-off-by: Nathan Chancellor <nathan@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Ingo Molnar <mingo@kernel.org>
Tested-by: Anthony Ruhier <aruhier@mailbox.org>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://github.com/ClangBuiltLinux/linux/issues/1374
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210518190106.60935-1-nathan@kernel.org

diff --git a/arch/x86/Makefile b/arch/x86/Makefile
index c77c5d8a7b3e..307529417021 100644
--- a/arch/x86/Makefile
+++ b/arch/x86/Makefile
@@ -178,11 +178,6 @@ ifeq ($(ACCUMULATE_OUTGOING_ARGS), 1)
 	KBUILD_CFLAGS += $(call cc-option,-maccumulate-outgoing-args,)
 endif
 
-ifdef CONFIG_LTO_CLANG
-KBUILD_LDFLAGS	+= -plugin-opt=-code-model=kernel \
-		   -plugin-opt=-stack-alignment=$(if $(CONFIG_X86_32),4,8)
-endif
-
 # Workaround for a gcc prelease that unfortunately was shipped in a suse release
 KBUILD_CFLAGS += -Wno-sign-compare
 #
@@ -202,7 +197,12 @@ ifdef CONFIG_RETPOLINE
   endif
 endif
 
-KBUILD_LDFLAGS := -m elf_$(UTS_MACHINE)
+KBUILD_LDFLAGS += -m elf_$(UTS_MACHINE)
+
+ifdef CONFIG_LTO_CLANG
+KBUILD_LDFLAGS	+= -plugin-opt=-code-model=kernel \
+		   -plugin-opt=-stack-alignment=$(if $(CONFIG_X86_32),4,8)
+endif
 
 ifdef CONFIG_X86_NEED_RELOCS
 LDFLAGS_vmlinux := --emit-relocs --discard-none
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `arch/x86/Makefile`**
1. The assignment of `KBUILD_LDFLAGS` was modified:
   - The line `KBUILD_LDFLAGS := -m elf_$(UTS_MACHINE)` was changed to `KBUILD_LDFLAGS += -m elf_$(UTS_MACHINE)`, allowing for the accumulation of linker flags rather than overwriting them.
2. The section that adds `-plugin-opt=` flags for `CONFIG_LTO_CLANG` was moved:
   - Previously, this section was placed before the `KBUILD_LDFLAGS` assignment, which caused it to be overwritten. It has now been relocated to after the `KBUILD_LDFLAGS` assignment to ensure these flags are retained.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `arch/x86/Makefile` are interrelated as they address the same issue of ensuring that the `-plugin-opt=` flags are correctly included in the linker flags. By changing the assignment operator from `:=` to `+=`, the patch ensures that all linker flags, including those for LTO (Link Time Optimization), are preserved and not overwritten. This change resolves the misalignment issues in the AMDGPU driver when compiling with `CONFIG_LTO_CLANG`, which was the root cause of the reported general protection faults. The adjustments made in the patch ensure that the build process correctly incorporates all necessary flags, thereby improving stability and functionality.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect placement of the `-plugin-opt=` flags in the `KBUILD_LDFLAGS` assignment, which led to these flags being overwritten and not included in the linker invocations. This omission resulted in misalignment issues in the AMDGPU driver when compiling with `CONFIG_LTO_CLANG`, ultimately causing general protection faults.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```makefile
KBUILD_LDFLAGS := -m elf_$(UTS_MACHINE)
ifdef CONFIG_LTO_CLANG
KBUILD_LDFLAGS	+= -plugin-opt=-code-model=kernel \
```
Reason:
The `KBUILD_LDFLAGS` is initially assigned with `:=`, which means it is evaluated immediately and any subsequent modifications to it (like the `-plugin-opt=` flags) are not included in the final value. This results in the `-plugin-opt=` flags being overwritten and not passed to the linker, causing misalignment issues in the AMDGPU driver.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```makefile
KBUILD_LDFLAGS += -m elf_$(UTS_MACHINE)
ifdef CONFIG_LTO_CLANG
KBUILD_LDFLAGS	+= -plugin-opt=-code-model=kernel \
```
Reason:
Changing the assignment of `KBUILD_LDFLAGS` to `+=` allows the flags to be appended rather than overwritten. This ensures that all linker flags, including the `-plugin-opt=` flags, are preserved and included in the linker invocations, thus preventing the misalignment issues and general protection faults.
